description: A MineCraft utility mod for peer-to-peer multiplayer.  Allows users to play using worlds in synced directories (Google Drive for desktop, syncthing, network drives, etc.) by providing mutex locking for shared worlds.  No more waiting for the host to start the world, play your MP world whenever you want!

mods.name: SharedWorlds
mods.description: Mutex Locks for file-synced MineCraft Worlds
